test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'FORCE' is written as '641832' and 'MIST' is written as '1331920'. How will 'URANUS' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Step 1: Consonants coded as its alphabet place value numerical.

Step 2: Vowel’s coded as position number of vowel’s position like,

A = 1; E = 2; I = 3; O = 4; U = 5

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eab7b1d16d7343bf4b81e0605086da24c70b9a327708186337b705592df19cf7.png] 

'FORCE' is written as '641832'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e006f2cc97c2c99329fd839ba51036b86bbde0e60b7efe64ab7e44f69a560e0a.png] 

And,

'MIST' is written as '1331920'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b11ac54755229818f97d7f53c2c0bd6bf29817736a30ffac3edf90424f94c18b.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **URANUS = ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2d1e325fa059862d198963c04f6f1d78a2a870057f16e156d3c97cd6c85e98a.png] 

Hence, 'URANUS' is coded as "**518114519**".
